title: Verifier-integrated LLM intent-to-configuration pipeline: end-to-end safety and rollback evaluation (repaired preregistration)
research_question: Does integrating an open-source formal network verifier (Batfish) into an LLM-driven intent-to-configuration pipeline measurably reduce unsafe configuration enactments and increase successful automatic rollback rates in controlled emulated NetOps scenarios?
confirmatory_hypotheses: H1: The LLM+verifier (block-on-violation) pipeline yields a lower per-task unsafe-enactment rate than the LLM-only pipeline (primary confirmatory test).

H2: When verifier-detected violations trigger the automated rollback procedure, end-to-end service-impact (canary reachability loss) is lower than under the LLM-only pipeline (secondary confirmatory test).
exploratory_questions: EQ1: How does intent ambiguity level (benign / ambiguous / partially-specified) modulate verifier effectiveness?
EQ2: What are common residual failure modes (verifier false negatives, LLM hallucinated config fragments, parser-level syntax failures)?
EQ3: How sensitive are results to small, deterministic prompt perturbations (prompt-sensitivity probe)?
benchmark_scope: CNSM-AI-NetOps-Intent-Bench-v1 (synthetic intent set generated under RFC1918 addressing conventions; three strata: benign, ambiguous, partially-specified)
Emulated multi-vendor routing/switching topologies implemented in containerized router images (Docker).
primary_estimand: Per-task unsafe-enactment rate difference (LLM-only minus LLM+verifier-block) measured on confirmatory tasks (absolute percentage-point reduction).
secondary_estimands: Conditional rollback success rate: proportion of verifier-detected violations that are automatically rolled back and for which declared invariants are restored within the emulation.
Median time-to-detect and median time-to-rollback (seconds) per detected violation.
sampling_plan: Two-stage design: deterministic pilot (30 tasks) followed by confirmatory run. Intents stratified equally across three ambiguity strata (benign, ambiguous, partially-specified). For each confirmatory task we execute all pipelines (LLM-only; LLM+verifier-block; LLM+verifier+automatic-rollback) on the same initial intent to support paired comparisons. Pilot validates harness and freezes parser/verifier mappings prior to confirmatory run.
power_and_precision_plan: Primary estimand target: detect an absolute reduction of 15 percentage points (e.g., from 30% to 15%). Using conservative paired-to-independent approximation, two-sided Bonferroni-adjusted alpha=0.025 and power=0.80, required confirmatory task count = 150 (recommended scenario). Report 95% binomial CIs for per-pipeline rates. Sensitivity analyses: recompute estimates excluding contaminated/infrastructure-missing tasks and perform worst/best-case imputations if infrastructure-missing >5%.
exclusion_rules: Auto-exclude any generated config containing non-RFC1918 public IP addresses or detected organization names (automatic exclusion from experimental corpus).
Auto-exclude tasks whose generated config triggers vendor-syntax parser failure (counted and reported; no human repair).
Auto-exclude tasks with exact-match to curated public-repo config fingerprints (contamination handling).
missingness_plan: Retry policy: up to 3 retries per model call with exponential backoff for transient provider/infrastructure failures. If a task has unresolved model/provider failures on both permitted hosted models (primary API and configured fallback per adapter) after retries, mark as 'infrastructure-missing' and exclude from confirmatory analyses only if infrastructure-missing ≤ 5% of confirmatory tasks; otherwise run and report sensitivity analyses (best/worst-case imputations). All missingness instances logged with error codes and hashes.
analysis_plan: Primary analysis: paired McNemar-style comparisons (task-level binary outcome: unsafe enactment yes/no) between LLM-only and LLM+verifier-block with two-sided alpha adjusted per multiplicity plan. Compute 95% binomial/confidence intervals for per-pipeline rates. Secondary: conditional proportions (rollback success) tested with Fisher exact tests. Report median and IQR for time-to-detect and time-to-rollback. Subgroup (strata) analyses are exploratory and unadjusted. All analysis implemented in deterministic scripts with fixed RNG seeds; preserve raw per-task log table for reproducibility.
multiplicity_plan: Two confirmatory comparisons (H1 primary, H2 secondary). Control family-wise error using Bonferroni adjustment (per-comparison alpha = 0.05/2 = 0.025). Exploratory subgroup analyses are unadjusted and explicitly labelled exploratory.

stopping_rule: Abort and halt the confirmatory run if >2% of planned confirmatory tasks are flagged as contaminated (preregistered stop-and-fix). Additionally, the pilot stage (30 tasks) must complete and validate parser/verifier mappings before any confirmatory execution; failures in pilot harness that cannot be resolved within scheduled automated retries abort the run.
planned_outputs: Deterministic experiment harness code, Docker emulation artifacts, and Batfish mappings.
Raw per-task logs, model-call transcripts, and hashes.
Analysis scripts and results tables (CSV/JSON) with exact seeds.
IEEE-format five-page short-paper LaTeX source, BibTeX, and compiled PDF (≤5 pages) including Disclosure Statement.
Contamination, missingness, and failure-mode logs and taxonomy.
